newsitem.title: USA: ITT Educational enrollment up nine percent.
newsitem.headline: ITT Educational enrollment up nine percent.

text.p: ITT Educational Services Inc said total student enrollment at its ITT Technical Institutes as of June 30 was up nine percent from the previous year at 23,994 students.
At institutes open more than 24 months, enrollment increased six percent to 23,001 students, the company said.
The company also reported a five percent increase in new student enrollment for the 1997 June term, with a total of 6,879 new students.
ITT operates a private college system focused on technology-related programs. It operates 60 institutes in 27 states.
